items.description: database password as a literal default of a variable, so it sits in the repository and in state
the subnet tagged private is associated with the route table that sends 0.0.0.0/0 to the internet gateway, so it is a public subnet
the edge security group is open to 0.0.0.0/0 on every TCP port
the db security group looks closed but allows 5432 from the edge group, which is open to the internet on every port, so the database is reachable from anywhere through it
iam:PassRole with Resource * next to ec2:RunInstances lets the deployer start an instance with any role in the account, including an admin role
privileged container that also mounts the host Docker socket: code in the pod controls the node and every other container on it
an unpinned install script is piped into sh as root during the image build, on top of an unpinned ubuntu:latest base
the pull request title is expanded inside a run script, so a crafted title runs shell commands in the job
pull_request_target checks out the pull request head and runs npm ci and the tests with a deploy secret in the environment, so a fork's code runs with the secret

decoys.description: public load balancer group open to 0.0.0.0/0 on 443 only, as intended
Principal * in a Deny statement that requires TLS; it restricts, it does not grant
adds NET_BIND_SERVICE after dropping ALL, non-root, read-only root file system
digest-pinned build base and npm ci --ignore-scripts
the title is passed through env and read as a quoted variable
